messages:
aisha.k: Heads-up — we have 7 onboarding customers impacted by the embedding degradation over the weekend. Need a short, consistent outbound and a tailored follow-up plan for priority accounts. Who can draft the initial comm and the credit offer?

 tom.z: I can sketch the comm. will include: incident summary, current status, mitigation steps, ETA for full restoration, and a one-time credit offer.

 priya.s: Add renewal/Risk note for accounts in their trial/negotiation window, please. I need the exact credit numbers to discuss with the buyer.

 rosa.support: For cases already escalated to support, I have case IDs and affected request logs. Can share a list privately.

 incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-20-EMB-02 recorded: embedding service latency spike 03/20 02:15-07:00 UTC. Root cause flagged as KV cache eviction under burst load.

 aisha.k: thanks. tom — can you post the draft here by EOD PST? Priya — we'll tag which accounts are under negotiation. Rosa — please DM me the case IDs and any promises already made.

 tom.z: Draft below — please edit. Keeping it short for CS + legal.

 ```
 Subject: Update: Temporary degradation impacting embeddings (Mar 20)

 Hi <customer name>,

 We wanted to let you know about a service degradation that affected embeddings between 02:15–07:00 UTC on Mar 20. During this window some requests experienced higher latency and a small number of requests returned 5xx errors.

 What we did: our on-call team rolled back a cache eviction change, reinstated prefix/KV caching, and applied a throttling rule to prevent recurrence.

 Current status: performance is restored; we continue to monitor and are running an extended validation pass over historical data.

 What we’re offering: a one-time credit equal to 3 days of embeddings consumption for affected accounts, plus a scheduled 1:1 onboarding check-in to review any data reprocessing.

 Next steps: If you saw any user-facing impact, reply and we’ll prioritize your reindex/retry batch.

 Apologies for the inconvenience — we take reliability seriously.

 Best,
 The Redwood CS team
 ```

 priya.s: Credit calc ok for most, but for accounts already in renewal talks I suggest 5 days equivalent or an SLA credit. Can legal approve?

 aisha.k: Priya — noted. Rosa — any customers who already had live production traffic hit? We should escalate them to higher credit.

 rosa.support: Two accounts had production-facing errors: acct-124 and acct-338. I logged them as cases #4521 and #4526. Both requested support for reindex jobs; we queued them.

 aisha.k: Okay. Action items: 1) tom finalize template and variable placeholders (owner: tom.z) 2) priya confirm list of negotiation-window customers and proposed uplift (owner: priya.s) 3) rosa send case list and current promises (owner: rosa.support) 4) aisha to approve final comm and send outbound by 18:00 PST.

 tom.z: I'll update draft with a short prod-impact addendum for acct-124 & acct-338 and include a calendar link for the 1:1.

 priya.s: I'll DM Aisha the list and proposed uplift amounts.

 aisha.k: If legal needs to edit language, loop them in now. Also thinking of a short post-send survey to capture customer sentiment and any outstanding issues — two quick questions. Agree?

 tom.z: agree. I'll add a link to a 2-question form.

 rosa.support: Sent the case IDs to Aisha and attached the logs.

 aisha.k: Thanks team. Final approval gate at 17:30 PST — please ping if you need more time. We'll track outreach and any follow-ups in the account notes.

 priya.s: Thx — will be on standby for replies and to escalate renewal risks.

 incident-bot: Note: follow-up health check scheduled 2026-03-22 15:00 UTC.

 aisha.k: Closing the loop here — we’ll post the sent copy in #customer-success after deployment and follow up to prioritize reindex jobs.
